package.name: sparky_localization
package.description:
State estimation for the UWRobotics Sparky rover. Runs the standard robot_localization dual-EKF + navsat_transform stack:
- ekf_local : wheel odom + VN-300 IMU -> continuous odom->base_link (heading-drift compensated; NO GPS dependency) - navsat_transform + ekf_global : adds VN-300 GNSS -> drift-corrected map->odom for global navigation (Nav2 GPS waypoints)
The GPS half is opt-in (use_gps launch arg); with use_gps:=false only the local EKF runs, giving a fully functional estimate without any GPS.
package.author: UWRobotics Team
